question: In football, a kick is awarded to the opposition player when a player has committed a foul. What is the kick called?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Free-kick**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **free kick** is awarded to the opposing team when a player commits a foul, making it the correct response.
 
• The foul can occur anywhere on the field, and the location of the free kick depends on where the foul happened.
 
• There are **two types** of free kicks:
 
 
• **Direct Free Kick**:
 
 
• The player taking the kick can directly aim for the goal.
 
 
 
• **Indirect Free Kick**:
 
 
• The ball must touch another player before a goal can be scored. 
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A **bicycle kick is a skilful move** used to strike the ball in mid-air.​

 
 
• The player launches their body **backwards** into the air, often while facing away from the goal.
 
• The bicycle kick is an **advanced skill** that requires timing, coordination, and athleticism.
 
 
 
• A** goal kick** is given when the attacking team last touches the ball before it crosses the goal line without a goal being scored.
